== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A force-blade is a weapon consisting of a hilt that, when activated, ignites a laser-edged plane of light. These blades vary significantly in appearance, manifesting in colors such as gold, red, white, blue, [[sapphire]], and orange. They range in size from standard three-foot or five-foot lengths to massive broadswords that can be as large as the user's body, and some are even scaled to fit mechs. While they can be carried on a belt or hip, they are often used in conjunction with [[Combat Arts]], which allow users to channel [[Aether]] to perform specialized strikes, create shields of flame, or release massive waves of energy. Although they are highly effective in duels and combat, some versions are specifically tuned to be weaker than protective armor so that they may injure rather than kill opponents. However, when combined with powerful techniques or used by certain entities, they can be devastating enough to bisect targets or even delete them from existence.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Queen Shyrax]] is known to carry and utilize a force-blade during her reign. While she possesses a generic version of the weapon, other individuals also wield these implements. Notably, [[Raion Raithe]] employs a force-blade during his encounters, eventually using the weapon to stab [[Starhammer]].}}
